title: chore: rotate InferencePort API key
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Replaces `INFERENCEPORT_API_KEY` in encrypted dev, staging, and production secret files.
- Leaves every other decrypted secret unchanged.
- Validates the replacement token against InferencePort.
- Passes all 17 focused InferencePort/Trellis 2 tests.

After merge, promote `main` to `production`; the production deployment workflow will sync the encrypted production secret through CI.

gist.headline: Fresh key in the hive
gist.blurb: The InferencePort key got a quiet seasonal refresh across dev, staging, and production. The bees checked it works before putting it back in the lockbox.
gist.summary: Rotated the encrypted INFERENCEPORT_API_KEY in gen.pollinations.ai dev, staging, and production secrets, with the replacement validated against InferencePort and 17 focused InferencePort/Trellis 2 tests passing.
gist.impact: InferencePort-backed generation keeps its authenticated connection refreshed consistently across all deployment environments.
gist.visual_concept: Polli acts as a careful garden keeper replacing a tiny glowing API key in three labeled seed vaults for dev, staging, and production, while a cozy terminal confirms the connection is healthy; surrounding code-plants signal reliable infrastructure growth.
